preconditions.description: The number of rows in the labyrinth is between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns in the labyrinth is between 1 and 2000.
The starting row index is between 1 and n.
The starting column index is between 1 and m.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the left is between 0 and 10^9.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the right is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(row == '.' or row == '*' for row in labyrinth)
preconditions.description: Each row in the labyrinth consists only of symbols '.' and '*'.
The starting cell contains no obstacles.

postconditions.description: The number of reachable cells is between 0 and the total number of cells in the labyrinth.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < m for i, j in reachable_cells)
postconditions.description: All reachable cells are within the boundaries of the labyrinth.

postconditions.expression: all(labyrinth[i][j] == '.' for i, j in reachable_cells)
postconditions.description: All reachable cells are free cells.
The return value is the number of reachable cells.
